title: Is Canopy working right now?
intro: This page reads the live services: the keeper that sends exits, the indexer that follows the chain, the watchers that confirm alarms, and the checks that run on your alarms. It shows no wallet addresses.

verdict.ok: Everything we can measure looks normal.
verdict.bad: Something needs attention. Your alarms stay armed, but an exit could be late.

error.title: The status service is not reachable right now.
error.body: That may mean something is wrong, or it may only be your connection. Your positions stay in your wallet and the chain is not affected. Try again in a moment.

keeper.title: Keeper
keeper.about: Sends the exit when an alarm fires. It pays gas only and can only pay the position's owner.

indexer.title: Indexer
indexer.about: Follows the chain and records positions and alarms.

watchers.title: Watchers
watchers.about: Independent operators who confirm an alarm before it fires. A watcher only signs when it sees a real problem, so a long quiet spell is normal.

checks.title: Alarm checks
checks.about: How recently the services last looked at the vaults your alarms watch.
checks.stale: Checks have not run for a while.

history.title: Recent admin and guardian changes
history.about: Changes to the router's settings and to the list of watchers. Each one is a transaction you can open and read on the explorer.
history.empty: No admin or guardian changes recorded recently.

firings.title: Alarm firings, last 7 days
firings.about: Each time an alarm fired. A firing does not always mean an exit: only armed positions exit.
firings.empty: No alarms fired in the last 7 days.

footer: Some times are accurate only to within ten minutes. This page asks for no wallet and keeps nothing about you.
